prompt: A tiny, paved shared back garden filmed from a fixed upstairs window far away, looking down through the slightly dirty glass at Brandon from behind, small in the centre of the frame, on a faded stripy deckchair facing the sun with his shorts round his ankles and his legs apart. We only see his back and the back of his head. Around him are a rotary washing line, a few weeds in cracked paving, a wheelie bin and a low brick wall, and the light is bright midday sun casting short hard shadows. Flat, washed-out colour, a bit of reflection from the window glass in one corner and mild compression. Thanks.
